description: 菲利多尔防御 C41 — 弃子打开d线，车侵入d7一举定乾坤

intro.popup:
线路控制第6课
白方主动弃子打开d线
车抢占D线， 黑方被全面压制
intro.popup_en:
Line Control, Lesson 6
White sacrifices material to open the d-file, then seizes it with a rook and puts Black under pressure.

outro.popup:
Rxd7侵入，兑换连击，白方赢后！
打开线路不是目的——立刻用车侵入才是。
线路控制 = 打开 + 即刻参战！
outro.popup_en:
Rxd7 penetrates and triggers a winning exchange sequence. Opening a file is not the goal by itself: bring a rook in immediately.
File control = open the line + use it at once.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 1.e4 — 开放局，d线将成为主战场。
e4 开局，本局的核心是 d 线——白方将用一系列手段把 d 线彻底打开。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 1.e4 - An open game where the d-file will become the main battleground.
White will use a series of exchanges and sacrifices to clear the file.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 1...e5 — 菲利多尔防御的起点。
黑方 e5 对称占中心，但下一步选择 d6 而非 Nf6，进入菲利多尔防御——以稳固为主，代价是子力发展稍慢。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 1...e5 - The Philidor Defense begins.
Black mirrors White in the center and will choose ...d6 rather than ...Nf6, building a solid setup at the cost of slower development.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 2.Nf3 — 白马出动，攻击 e5。
Nf3 攻击 e5，迫使黑方应对，同时为 d4 推进做准备。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 2.Nf3 - Develop and attack e5.
The knight pressures e5 and prepares the d4 advance.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 2...d6 — 菲利多尔！兵链封住 d 线。
d6 保护 e5关键点：d6 兵现在占着 d 线，白方将想办法清除它！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 2...d6 - The Philidor structure blocks the d-file.
The pawn supports e5. Key point: the pawn on d6 occupies the d-file, which White will try to clear.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 3.d4 — 白方推中心，挑战 e5！
d4 直接攻击 e5，逼黑方表态。若 exd4，d 线开放；若 e4，d 线被关闭但兵型冒进。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 3.d4 - White challenges the center and e5!
The pawn attacks e5 and asks Black to choose. After ...exd4 the d-file may open; an advance to ...e4 would close it but overextend the pawn.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 3...Bg4 — 黑象出来钉住 f3 马！
黑方 Bg4 钉住 Nf3，若马移走 d4 无人保护。看似聪明，但这步给了白方机会——接下来白方用两次兑换彻底打开 d 线！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 3...Bg4 - Black pins the f3-knight!
If the knight moves, d4 may lose its defender. The pin looks useful, but it gives White a chance to clear the d-file with a sequence of exchanges.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 4.dxe5 — 白方主动吃 e5！第一步打开 d 线！
dxe5 吃掉 e5，d4 兵消失，d 线开始清理。现在 d 线上只剩黑方的 d6 兵。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 4.dxe5 - White captures on e5 and starts clearing the d-file!
The d-pawn leaves d4. Black's d6-pawn is now the last pawn blocking the file.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 4...Bxf3 — 黑象吃马！
黑方兑换 Bxf3，吃掉被钉住的 f3 马。但现在白方可以用后吃回，后到 f3 后视线大开，d 线的控制将更加直接。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 4...Bxf3 - Black exchanges the bishop for the pinned knight.
White can recapture with the queen, placing it actively on f3 and preparing more direct pressure on the d-file.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 5.Qxf3 — 白后到 f3！视野大开！
后到 f3，控制 d5、a8-h1 对角线，同时瞄准 d 线方向。现在白方想清除 d 线上最后的障碍——d6 兵。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 5.Qxf3 - The queen recaptures on f3!
From f3 it eyes d5, the a8-h1 diagonal, and the d-file. White is ready to remove the last blocker, the pawn on d6.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 5...dxe5 — 黑方 d6 兵消失！d 线完全打开！
黑方 d6 吃 e5，d 线上最后的障碍移走了——d 线从 d1 到 d8 完全畅通！ 🎯 这是本局的关键时刻：d 线开放，白方必须立刻行动！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 5...dxe5 - The d6-pawn leaves the file!
Black captures on e5, clearing the final blocker. The d-file is now open from d1 to d8. 🎯 This is the critical moment: White should use the open file immediately.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 6.Bc4 — 象出动，瞄准 f7！
象到 c4，瞄准 f7 要害，同时配合后在 f3 形成对黑方王翼的双重威胁。白方子力迅速协调，为长易位后用车占 d 线做准备。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 6.Bc4 - Develop the bishop and target f7!
The bishop and queen on f3 coordinate against Black's kingside. White prepares to castle long and place a rook on the open d-file.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 6...Nf6 — 黑马出动，保护 e4。
Nf6 发展，保护 e4 格，但黑方开局已经落后——象被兑换、d 线被打开，白方占有明显的线路优势。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 6...Nf6 - Develop and guard e4.
Black brings out a knight, but White has opened the d-file and gained a clear advantage in line control.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 7.Qb3 — 后转 b3，双攻 f7 和 b7！
后到 b3，与 Bc4 联手双攻 f7，同时威胁 b7 兵。黑方必须同时应对两个威胁，被迫走出防守步。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 7.Qb3 - The queen attacks f7 and b7!
Working with Bc4, the queen pressures f7 and also eyes b7. Black must respond to two threats at once.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 7...Qe7 — 黑后到 e7 防守 f7。
黑方只能用后来挡住 f7 的威胁，但后在 e7 挡住了 f8 象的出路，阵型更加拥挤。黑方越来越难以应对。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 7...Qe7 - The queen defends f7.
Black meets the threat, but the queen blocks the bishop on f8 and leaves Black's pieces cramped.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 8.Nc3 — 白马出动，增援进攻！
Nc3 发展，支援 d5 和 e4，完善进攻阵型。白方现在后（b3）+象（c4）+马（c3）全部指向黑方王翼，下一步是弃子连击！
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 8.Nc3 - Develop another attacker!
The knight supports central squares and joins the queen and bishop in targeting Black's kingside. White is preparing a tactical sacrifice.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 8...c6 — 黑方试图保护 b5。
c6 防止白方 Nb5，但留下了 b5 格的临时弱点——白方将在下一步利用这个时机发动弃子攻击！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 8...c6 - Black tries to secure b5.
The move prevents Nb5 but creates a temporary weakness on b5, which White can exploit tactically.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 9.Bg5 — 象到 g5，钉住 f6 马！
Bg5 钉住 Nf6（f6 马若动，e7 后暴露在 Bc4 象的攻击下，且 f7 再无防守）。黑方的防线越来越脆弱。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 9.Bg5 - Pin the knight on f6!
If it moves, the queen on e7 may become exposed to Bc4 and f7 may lose a defender. Black's position is under increasing pressure.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 9...b5 — 黑方试图驱逐 Bc4！
b5 攻击 c4 象，想解除威胁。但这步正中白方圈套——弃马连击马上开始！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 9...b5 - Black attacks the bishop on c4!
Black hopes to relieve the pressure, but this move allows White's tactical knight sacrifice.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 10.Nxb5！— 弃马！连击开始！
白马弃子吃 b5！看起来是白送一马——实际上是打开黑方阵型缺口的关键一步。cxb5 之后，Bxb5+ 将军，黑方必须阻挡，d 线的争夺即将到来！
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 10.Nxb5! - The knight sacrifice begins!
The knight captures on b5 and appears to be given away, but the move opens a weakness. After ...cxb5, Bxb5+ forces a block and sets up the invasion on the d-file.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 10...cxb5 — 黑方吃马。
黑方只能接受弃子，吃掉 b5 马。但 c6 兵移走，c 线开放，Bxb5+ 将军即将到来，黑王完全暴露！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 10...cxb5 - Black accepts the sacrifice.
The c-pawn leaves c6, opening lines. White can now give Bxb5+ and expose Black's king.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 11.Bxb5+！— 将军！黑方必须用马挡！
象到 b5 将军，黑方只有一个选择：Nbd7 用马挡。但这样 d7 格被马占据，d 线方向将有马可换——为 Rxd7 创造条件！
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 11.Bxb5+! - Check!
Black must block with ...Nbd7. The knight on d7 becomes a target on the d-file, preparing the rook's invasion.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 11...Nbd7 — 马挡将，但 d7 成为靶子！
唯一的应对是 Nbd7 挡将，但马在 d7 正好堵在 d 线上——下一步白方长易位，车立刻进驻 d 线，直取 d7！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 11...Nbd7 - The knight blocks the check but becomes a target!
It stands directly on the d-file. White can castle long and bring a rook to the file, aiming at d7.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 12.O-O-O！— 长易位，车瞬间对准 d 线！
长易位后，d1 的车立刻对准完全开放的 d 线，直接瞄准 d7 的马！这一步同时完成了王的安全和重子的激活——线路控制的完美体现！
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 12.O-O-O! - Castle long and seize the d-file!
The rook on d1 immediately targets the knight on d7. One move secures the king and activates a heavy piece on the open file.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 12...Rd8 — 黑方车到 d8，拼死保 d7！
黑方唯一应对是 Rd8 保护 d7 马。但这只是徒劳——白方 Rxd7 仍然可以执行，因为兑换后整个局面对黑方是灾难性的！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 12...Rd8 - Black desperately defends d7.
The rook protects the knight, but White can still invade with Rxd7 and emerge with a decisive advantage after the exchanges.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 13.Rxd7！— 车侵入 d7！d 线控制化为致命实战！
白车吃 d7 马！尽管 Nxd7 可以吃回，但接下来 Bxe7 赢后，黑方损失惨重。 🎯 这就是「打开线路，立刻参战」的最直观体现：d 线一打开，车立刻侵入，不给对方任何喘息机会！
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 13.Rxd7! - The rook invades!
White captures the knight. If Black recaptures with ...Nxd7, Bxe7 wins the queen.
🎯 This is the principle in action: as soon as the file opens, invade before the opponent can reorganize.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 13...Nxd7 — 黑方只能吃回。
黑方用 Nxd7 吃回，但已无法避免接下来的连击：Bxe7 赢走黑方的后！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 13...Nxd7 - Black has to recapture.
But the follow-up Bxe7 wins Black's queen.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 14.Bxe7 — 白方赢后！
Bg5 象吃掉 e7 的后！黑方失去王后，局面彻底崩溃。这一切都源于弃子打开 d 线、车侵入 d7 的连锁效应。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 14.Bxe7 - White wins the queen!
The bishop from g5 captures on e7. Black loses the queen after the sequence set up by opening the d-file and invading d7.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 14...Bxe7 — 黑方只能用象吃回。
黑方用 Bxe7 吃回，损失了后换来一象——已经输掉了局面。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 14...Bxe7 - Black recaptures with the bishop.
Black has traded the queen for a bishop and is in a losing position.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 15.Bxd7+！— 白象将军，再赢一马！
白方 Bxb5 象（现已吃至 d7）再次将军，吃掉 d7 马！黑方已经亏损了一后一马，局面毫无希望。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 15.Bxd7+! - Check and win another knight!
The bishop that captured on b5 now takes the knight on d7 with check. Black has lost the queen and a knight, with no realistic chances left.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 15...Rxd7 — 黑方用车吃回。
🏁 第6局总结——「弃子打开 d 线，车侵入即刻制胜」：
• Nxb5+Bxb5 弃子打破黑方阵型，d线完全打开
• O-O-O 长易位，车瞬间对准 d 线
• Rxd7 侵入，Bxe7 赢后，Bxd7+ 再赢马
线路控制的最高境界：打开线路 + 立刻参战 = 不可挡的攻势！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 15...Rxd7 - Black recaptures with the rook.
🏁 Game 6 summary: sacrifice to open the d-file, then invade immediately.
• Nxb5 and Bxb5+ break open Black's position.
• O-O-O places a rook on the open file.
• Rxd7 invades, Bxe7 wins the queen, and Bxd7+ wins another knight.
The key principle: open a line and use it at once.
